findings.description: Direct inspection of all eleven current V98 renders: both front-lap piping terminations still turn outward beyond the hem at the lower corners, including front and side views. The 12 mm endpoint recess has not produced flush endpoints.

Neutral, rear, side and three-quarter renders still show dense transverse ridges and pinching along both overskirt sides. Crouch and sit retain stiff angular panel overlap near the hips and raised thighs; the new endpoint inset does not address this independent drape issue.

The previews are prototype render evidence only. Geometry audit reports avatarFitVerified and buildReportPassed false; weight assignment/verification, Shape Key response, complete UV coverage, Unity/VRChat runtime, and release-package readiness remain unverified. No release gate passes.

nextAction: The 12 mm piping inset is still not visually flush, so stop increasing this offset blindly. Change the piping termination geometry itself (for example, terminate at a hem boundary vertex with a capped/flush transition) and alter the overskirt side-panel construction/deformation to remove the transverse ridges and hip bunching. Rebuild and inspect all current views, especially side, sit, and crouch. Keep UV evidence partial-unverified: authored panel UV exists, while sleeve, body shell, and hardware UVs are not verified. Do not infer fit or release acceptance from these previews.
